summary.name: Squash and Stretch: an explicit animation principle within Motion Design and Cinematography, not an independent art movement.
summary.visualIdentity: Explicitly plans anticipation, impact, compression or extension, rebound, and settling. Deformation follows movement while preserving apparent volume and recognizable silhouettes. Timing varies, with short holds.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: one expressive moment for a hero object or logo, or physical emphasis for characters or headline words. Inferred: product explainers, onboarding loops, title cards. Other uses are unspecified.
summary.limitations: Explicit: no uniform spring presets on unrelated objects and no continuous deformation. Basic XPBD omits fluid, viscosity, plasticity, tearing, rigid contact, and origami creases. Deformation limits are unspecified.
summary.palette: Reference-dependent example; the style has no intrinsic palette. Tokens: background #F4EDDF, foreground #32444A, accent_1 #66978E, accent_2 #C78461. Foreground on background is 8.745:1. Accents are decorative only, and gradients are off. Approved palettes override these.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: use pivots, key poses, controlled scale changes, and apparent-volume checks. Optional XPBD may assist elastic compression and settling under authored direction. Video runs from composition time. Optional references: motion-003 drop-and-growth, motion-006 gaze tracking, motion-012 chapter handoff, motion-015 narrative steps.
summary.audio: Unspecified in the source. Options are offered per topic: music, voiceover, sung vocals, sound effects, ambience, or silence. Inferred: restrained impact accents may suit compression moments. Music must not compete with speech.
summary.assetRequirements: Unspecified; no assets are supplied. Inferred needs: layered artwork with clear pivots, readable silhouettes, and eye layers or a rig for gaze motion. XPBD needs masses, rest geometry, compliance, damping, and collision settings.
summary.combinations: Explicit: use alone for one hero object or logo; hybridize when characters need a drawing language or typography must carry the message. Suggested: style-028 flat vector characters and style-093 kinetic type. Only acting objects deform.
summary.productionApproach: HyperFrames is the default for composition, timing, sync, validation, and export; Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation applies. SVG renders visuals and GSAP drives motion. Verify key frames and decoded video.
